subject: skill/flash-ladder/taskman
claim: For a single-session taskman-style Python library contract, a single TaskManager class exposing the contract methods passes reliably when tasks live in an id-keyed mapping (plain dicts or a small record class), dependencies are stored as explicit id lists, validation is concentrated in private _require/_validate_dependencies helpers, and cycle detection runs before any mutation; a single module or a thin manager.py split both pass (12/12 cells, 13/13 tests each).
